author: isXander
changes: Kotlin interpolation and geometric scroll zoom reimplemented as a Java frame-time state machine with configurable smooth durations.
Scale the incoming FOV by a zoom ratio; preserve other camera mods via non-cancelling ModifyReturnValue.
Use relative sensitivity on final mouse deltas without modifying Minecraft options.
Hold MMB default, remappable native key binding, deterministic Quick Commands collision handling.
Zoom is OFF by default; wheel bounds 1..100x; optional per-session retained tiers; release/focus/profile cancellation.
2026-10-14: restored Zoomify default affectHandFov behavior for both getFov paths; ported relative view bobbing injection and lerp formula.
Starting magnification and wheel now permit 100x; hand and bobbing behavior can be configured independently.

2026-10-15: ported TransitionInterpolator exponential in/out curves and inverse direction remapping from the pinned TransitionType.kt snapshot; normalized floating-point endpoints remove upstream integer-division endpoint discontinuity.
Initial zoom now defaults to 2.5x, with the upstream 1.0-second zoom-in and 0.5-second zoom-out transition times; zero duration remains explicitly instant.

Wheel interpolation is independent of the initial transition, operates in geometric tier space, and uses the continuous-time equivalent of the upstream 70% smoothing default to remain frame-rate independent.
Release folds current scroll and partial initial zoom into a continuous transition; repeated press/release and same-time renderer queries do not jump or accelerate it.
Camera animation no longer depends on the general GUI animations setting. The complete old 4x/0.20/0.15 default bundle migrates once; distinguishable custom configurations remain unchanged.
